Solution: Lower half: 2, 4, 6, 8 -> median = 5. Upper half: 10, 12, 14, 16 -> median = 13. IQR = 13 − 5 = 8

Solution: With 9 numbers, the median is the 5th number. So one data value must be exactly 15
